versions.content: BSW Service Execution on Local or Remote Partition Type: valid Description: If a BSW service is available on a specific partition, the BSWMDT shall allow to create a BSWMD for a given code that supports configurations where the service function is invoked and executed in the same partition as well as configurations where it is invoked in one partition and routed to a different one by the RTE. Rationale: Optimize load balancing between the cores w.r.t. BSW services. Increase efficiency of BSW service execution. Enable optimization of multi core SW distribution. Dependencies: – Use Case: Parallel execution of applications on a multi-core system. Supporting Material: –
